headline: Woolipop
title: Woolipop | Cotton Candy Ranch Pal | Palworld Guide
video_script: Woolipop is a Neutral Pal covered in cotton candy. You can find it in the early game around the Sea Breeze Archipelago. Assign it to a ranch and it sometimes drops Cotton Candy. Its partner skill, Candy Pop, also lowers how fast your base Pals get hungry, and it does not stack. Woolipop works Farming at level one. Is it on your ranch? Comment below!
description: Woolipop in Palworld 1.0: Neutral ranch Pal that drops Cotton Candy, with the Candy Pop partner skill reducing base Pal hunger. Checked on Pindrop and palworld.gg in November 2026.
